Name: Ethan, Son of Zerah
Summary: Son of Zerah, named among the five sons of Zerah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:6: Son of Zerah, named among the five sons of Zerah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ethan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
